description_en: Queries the configurations of an endpoint
kebab_example: aliyun ga list-custom-routing-endpoints --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --accelerator-id ga-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListCustomRoutingEndpoints

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最大值：50。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_zh: 待查询终端节点列表的全球加速实例ID
parameters.name: accelerator_id

parameters.help_zh: 待查询终端节点列表的监听ID
parameters.name: listener_id

parameters.help_zh: 待查询终端节点列表的终端节点组ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

AcceleratorId.description_en: The ID of the GA instance with which the endpoint is associated
AcceleratorId.description_zh: 终端节点所属全球加速实例ID

Endpoint.description_en: The name of the vSwitch that is specified as an endpoint
Endpoint.description_zh: 终端节点交换机（vSwitch）实例名称

EndpointGroupId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint group to which the endpoint belongs
EndpointGroupId.description_zh: 终端节点所属终端节点组ID

ListenerId.description_en: The ID of the listener to which the endpoint belongs

ServiceId.description_en:
The ID of the service that manages the GA instance.

This parameter is valid only if ServiceManaged is set to True
ServiceId.description_zh:
托管实例所属的服务方ID。

仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效

ServiceManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the GA instance is managed. Valid values:

true
false
ServiceManaged.description_zh:
是否为托管实例。取值：

true：是托管实例。

false：不是托管实例

ServiceManagedInfos.description_en:
The actions that users can perform on the managed instance.

This parameter is valid only if ServiceManaged is set to True.

Users can perform only specific actions on a managed instance
ServiceManagedInfos.description_zh:
用户在此托管实例下可执行的动作策略列表。

仅在ServiceManaged参数为True时有效。
当实例处于托管状态时，用户对实例的操作会受到限制，某些操作行为会被禁止

items.description_zh: 用户可在该托管实例执行的动作策略列表

Action.description_en:
The name of the action performed on the managed instance. Valid values:

Create
Update
Delete
Associate
UserUnmanaged
CreateChild
Action.description_zh:
托管策略动作名称，取值：
Create：创建实例。
Update：更新当前实例。
Delete：删除当前实例。
Associate：引用/被引用当前实例。
UserUnmanaged：用户解托管实例。
CreateChild：在当前实例下创建子资源

ChildType.description_en:
The type of the child resource. Valid values:

Listener: listener
IpSet: acceleration region
EndpointGroup: endpoint group
ForwardingRule: forwarding rule
Endpoint: endpoint
EndpointGroupDestination: protocol mapping of an endpoint group associated with a custom routing listener
EndpointPolicy: traffic policy of an endpoint associated with a custom routing listener

This parameter is valid only if Action is set to CreateChild
ChildType.description_zh:
子资源类型，取值：

Listener：监听资源。

IpSet：加速地域资源。

EndpointGroup：终端节点组资源。

ForwardingRule：转发策略资源。

Endpoint：终端节点资源。

EndpointGroupDestination：自定义路由监听下的终端节点组协议映射资源。

EndpointPolicy：自定义路由监听下的终端节点通行策略资源。

仅在Action参数为CreateChild时有效

IsManaged.description_en:
Indicates whether the specified actions are managed. Valid values:

true: The specified actions are managed, and users cannot perform the specified actions on the managed resource.
false: The specified actions are not managed, and users can perform the specified actions on the managed resource
IsManaged.description_zh:
托管策略动作是否被托管，取值：
true：托管策略动作被托管，用户无权在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作。
false：托管策略动作未被托管，用户可在托管实例下执行Action指定的操作

TrafficToEndpointPolicy.description_en:
The access policy of traffic that is destined for the endpoint. Valid values:

AllowAll: allows all traffic to the endpoint.
DenyAll: denies all traffic to the endpoint.
AllowCustom: allows traffic only to specified destinations
TrafficToEndpointPolicy.description_zh:
后端服务流量通行策略。

AllowAll：允许所有访问流量访问指定后端服务。

DenyAll：拒绝所有访问流量访问指定后端服务。

AllowCustom：指定可以接收访问流量的通行目标

Type.description_en:
The backend service type of the endpoint.

Only PrivateSubNet may be returned, which indicates a private CIDR block
Type.description_zh:
终端节点后端服务类型。

 PrivateSubNet：私网CIDR

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
